story.heading: Our background and values

photo.alt: DSS members gathered in front of Sather Tower on the UC Berkeley campus
photo.caption: DSS Fall 2025 Members

paragraphs: Founded in 2016, Data Science Society at Berkeley is UC Berkeley's **first undergraduate student organization** focused on data science.

Throughout the past decade, we have taken on **90+ client projects**, taught thousands of students through our DeCal, and hosted dozens of inclusive events on campus, all while watching the Data Science major grow into the **largest major at Berkeley**.

We've continually evolved to stay at the forefront of a rapidly changing field, ensuring that our members and the broader Berkeley community develop the skills they need to succeed as data scientists, machine learning researchers, and software engineers.

values.title: Open to all
values.body: We welcome students from **every major, background, and skill level**. We want to help anyone who's **curious about technology** achieve their goals.

values.title: Community first
values.body: DSS is a tight-knit support network. We grow together through **mentorship**, **hard work**, and **celebrating our shared successes**.

values.title: Skill development
values.body: Through our client projects, teaching, and new member development, we aim to **transform beginners** into **leaders** and innovators in industry.

values.title: Forward looking
values.body: Technology is rapidly changing. Our curriculum, projects, and mindset are constantly evolving to ensure we **stay ahead** of where the field is heading.

committees.heading: Find your committee
committees.subtext: We offer three different ways for people of all backgrounds and interests to get involved with data science and machine learning within our organization.

community.heading: Our Community
community.subtext: DSS has many traditions that help you feel included in a close and friendly community at Berkeley.

events.heading: Events We Host
events.subtext: Our club hosts events for members and the wider Berkeley community alike. From career fairs to hackathons, we give students the chance to build real technical skills and find their way within the industry.
